title: The pre-build design flow: alternatives and contracts settled, and the Design DoR/DoD closed by a human at the gate

steps.claim: the run was governed before it changed anything — the contract was active before the first write, not declared after the fact
readiness was established before the work started — a DoR that passed, ahead of the first write
the definition of done was checked before anything claimed the work was finished
steps.reason: the design-only evaluation stops for human approval; build Definition of Done is not yet applicable

steps.claim: the design flow dispatched its governed product and designer roles through the host instead of executing them inline
the proposed graph, contracts, boundaries, and Design DoR/DoD passed the mechanical design gate before human approval
nothing expensive was derived twice — the diff, the blast radius and the graph scan were each computed once and shared
steps.reason: the design-only run stops at design approval before an implementation diff or shared review envelope exists; design graph evidence is evaluated separately by D2
